quotes.name: Marguerite Kimball-Ostrow
quotes.quote: I didn't really have a strategy on Sunday or Wednesday nights. I just flew through the systems one by one, and it happened to come out even on credits. I wasn't really focusing on that; I was just trying to explore and see where the show would take me.

quotes.name: Manju Abebe
quotes.quote: My Monday and Thursday night routes on UNDOCKED were pretty different. On Monday, I went through Sol, Alpha Centauri, and a bunch of other stars, earning 9 points for Wanderer and a few other badges. Thursday night, I took a different path, starting with Sirius and Nova Terra, and earned Cartographer again, but with fewer points. Both nights, I came out even on credits and flew until the show's time ran out.

quotes.name: Soo Loo
quotes.quote: I think what changed between Tuesday and Friday nights was my strategy and the contracts I took. On Tuesday, I focused on the First Hunt: Belt-Grazers contract and sold some iron ore, but I got into a few fights. By Friday, I'd finished the First Hunt contract for a big payout and took on more contracts that rewarded exploration and trading, like Copper Requisition and Market Participation: Selling. I also sold more resources, which helped my credits. It was a more varied and successful approach, I guess.
